# Open SAFE Europe

Open-source drafting of SAFE agreements for European startup founders.
The bundled template is general, not adapted to national law. No legal review or insurance assurance is claimed.

- Website: https://open-safe-europe.pages.dev
- API schema: https://open-safe-europe.pages.dev/api/schema
- Source and API guide: https://github.com/zabrodsk/open-safe-europe
- Agent skill: https://github.com/zabrodsk/open-safe-europe/tree/main/skills/open-safe-europe
- Install: npx skills add zabrodsk/open-safe-europe --skill open-safe-europe

POST /api/validate and /api/draft accept {"data":{...}}. POST /api/export also accepts format: txt, docx or pdf and optional edited text.
API requests are processed by Cloudflare. Browser drafting stays local. No API key required.
